title: Animated Totem
description: this ressource-pack make your totems animated
body:
# Animated Totem Outline

This simple resource pack adds a clean, animated green outline effect around the vanilla Totem of Undying.

### Features:
* **Animated Outline:** A smooth, looping green aura animated directly around the edges of the totem.
* **Vanilla Friendly:** Keeps the original textures and look of the default Minecraft totem.

### Requirements:
* This is a standard animated texture pack. It works completely in vanilla Minecraft without requiring OptiFine or any extra mods!
